title: Document frontend to backend domain boundaries
acceptance_criteria: The documented system overview identifies frontend ownership and inferred backend responsibilities
Domain boundaries for auth, chat, knowledge, and admin flows are described consistently with existing repository structure
No implementation code is introduced

title: Validate root application state responsibilities
acceptance_criteria: The responsibilities of the stateful app entrypoint and layout shell are clearly separated
State domains for auth, sessions, chat, knowledge, admin, and theme are identified
Planned follow-up work does not assume undocumented component ownership

title: Confirm API client configuration contract
acceptance_criteria: Base URL resolution, timeout handling, token storage, and API prefix behavior are documented
Refresh token retry behavior is accounted for in integration planning
Environment-driven configuration is preserved without hardcoded endpoint expansion

title: Define backend auth endpoint contract
acceptance_criteria: Required auth endpoints for register, login, logout, refresh, me, password change, and reset are enumerated
Expected token payload requirements are identified for frontend persistence
Admin auth operations are listed separately from end-user auth flows

title: Map login and session recovery UI flow
acceptance_criteria: Login, registration, logout, and session recovery entry points are identified
Required UI states for loading, success, and failure are captured
Existing E2E auth coverage can be traced to the documented flow

title: Define chat request and response contract
acceptance_criteria: Chat payload fields for session, message, model, reasoning effort, knowledge document, web search, and images are enumerated
Streaming and non-streaming response modes are described separately
Error and unauthorized retry paths are accounted for in the contract

title: Define chat session and message persistence requirements
acceptance_criteria: Backend requirements for session creation, listing, deletion, and message history retrieval are documented
Pagination metadata requirements are defined for message history endpoints
Usage metrics dependencies are captured for user quota reporting

title: Map chat composer and transcript UI responsibilities
acceptance_criteria: Composer responsibilities for prompt entry, model selection, web search, and attachment handling are identified
Transcript responsibilities for markdown rendering, metadata display, and source expansion are identified
State handoff between root orchestration and chat components is documented

title: Define knowledge ingestion and retrieval contract
acceptance_criteria: Upload, text ingest, list, chunk inspection, job inspection, search, reindex, and delete operations are enumerated
Session-scoped and global document behavior is distinguished
Async indexing and polling expectations are documented

title: Define knowledge indexing pipeline responsibilities
acceptance_criteria: Backend responsibilities for document storage, chunking, indexing, search, and job state transitions are documented
Failure states for ingestion and reindex workflows are identified
Retrieval outputs needed by the chat experience are captured

title: Map knowledge panel and chat import UI flows
acceptance_criteria: Knowledge panel responsibilities for search, listing, inspection, reindex, and delete are identified
Chat-side knowledge import entry points are identified separately from the dedicated knowledge panel
Existing E2E knowledge scenarios can be traced to the documented workflows

title: Define administrative analytics contract
acceptance_criteria: Admin-only endpoints for users, role changes, analytics, audit logs, and cost metrics are enumerated
Role-sensitive integration assumptions are documented
The contract distinguishes operational telemetry from end-user knowledge features

title: Map admin panel presentation and navigation flow
acceptance_criteria: Admin navigation entry points and view switching behavior are identified
User management and reporting display responsibilities are separated from service-layer concerns
Planned changes preserve the current layout shell structure

title: Validate model catalog and reasoning effort configuration
acceptance_criteria: Supported and available model definitions are documented
Thinking effort behavior is traced from configuration to UI usage
Any future model changes are recognized as requiring coordinated test updates

title: Map end-to-end coverage to functional domains
acceptance_criteria: Auth, chat, and knowledge tests are mapped to documented features
Mock API responsibilities are identified as a browser-layer contract test harness
Known gaps between mocked coverage and real backend behavior are documented

title: Document deployment and runtime configuration dependencies
acceptance_criteria: Deployment artifacts and environment variables are cataloged
Static frontend hosting and backend API dependency are documented together
Build-time versus runtime configuration constraints are identified

title: Keep root documentation synchronized with generated planning artifacts
acceptance_criteria: The plan and task inventory remain consistent with repository-level and frontend-level README files
Documentation reflects inferred backend architecture without overstating confirmed implementation details
All planning tasks remain atomic and executable
